title: 24s zombie-city action thriller
prompt_text: Video prompt: Cinematic 24-second action-thriller short, 16:9, 30fps, realistic, high-detail. Dynamic handheld camera, dramatic daylight, slightly desaturated blockbuster color grade. Character: young woman with long dark hair with purple-magenta highlights, white double-breasted short coat with red ribbon bow collar, black mini skirt, black knee-high boots, panicked/determined expression. Setting: dense modern Asian city, huge skyscrapers, massive crowd, clear blue sky. Shot 1 (0–2s): Close-up rooftop skylight with a zombie-like swarm of figures below reaching up. Shot 2 (2–4s): She leaps onto a yellow rope swinging across buildings. Shot 3 (4–8s): Top-down grip of a rusted fire-escape ledge, then rappelling down. Shot 4 (8–11s): Swinging toward a high window. Shot 5 (11–13s): Crashing into an empty office floor, glass fracturing. Shot 6 (13–18s): Sprinting down a corridor with a motion-blurred horde behind. Shot 7 (18–20s): Rear shot to a rooftop terrace. Shot 8 (20–24s): Exterior glass facade climb, wide building shot. Mood: survival, adrenaline, vertigo. Fast cuts, strong motion blur, wind and debris, realistic physics.
